name: Rotten Heart
source:
You can find Rotten Heart on itch.io!
You’ve transferred to a new high school to finish the school year after a difficult time at your old one. As you try to find your place among your new classmates, a frog-obsessed boy makes settling in surprisingly easy. He’s friendly, attentive, and always eager to help… though he may have a few strange quirks of his own.
translation:
你可以在itch.io上找到《Rotten Heart》！
在原本的学校经历了一段艰难时光后，你转学来到一所新高中读完这一学年。正当你努力在新同学之间寻找容身之处时，一名痴迷青蛙的男生让你意外轻松地融入了新环境。他友善体贴、热心助人……只不过，他自己身上似乎也有一些古怪的小癖好。
